exposure: Sources of sexual health information (parents/guardians, formal sources, Internet)
Topics covered by sexual health information
outcome: Sexual behavior (no sexual contact, sexual contact without condomless anal sex, condomless anal sex)
cohort: The study included 207 adolescent males, aged 14-17, who are interested in sex with males, residing in the United States.
finding: Adolescent males interested in sex with males receive sexual health information from various sources but prefer sexually-explicit online programs specifically addressing male-male sex to develop healthy sexual behaviors and decrease HIV/STI risk.
